body: I notice the small puppy whimpering pitifully from behind the pile of boxes in the shed. Its fur is matted with dirt, and its eyes look lost. My heart goes out to it; I can't imagine being trapped like this. I quickly gather some twigs and branches from my garden and lay them gently on top of the puppies' body. "Don't worry," I whisper, feeling a surge of protectiveness. "They'll be fine." I step aside but remain close enough so I'm always there if they need me.
